data.tagline: Driven by the chase. Focused on what’s next.
data.bio:
The work happens long before the lights come on. I’m a wide receiver who brings the same energy to the classroom, the weight room, and every snap.

I grew up running routes in the street with my older brother, and I still play like I’m trying to catch him. Still learning. Always competing.

custom.title: Beyond the game
custom.body:
Summers I help run a reading program for kids at the Linden rec center. Most of them come for the football drills after. I’m fine with that.

I also make the playlist for the locker room. Nobody has complained yet.

data.nilInterests: Local businesses that show up for Columbus kids: training gear, food spots, anything that gets more kids into the game.
